</script>

<script id="hojaR17MTutorialAudioBridge">
(()=>{'use strict';
let context=null;const buffers=new Map();let activeSnore=null;let lastAt=Object.create(null);let played=0;
function unlockFromGesture(){
 try{context=context||new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();context.resume().catch(()=>{});}
 catch(_e){}
}
function decodeUri(uri){
 const comma=uri.indexOf(',');const bytes=atob(uri.slice(comma+1));
 return Uint8Array.from(bytes,c=>c.charCodeAt(0)).buffer;
}
async function playAudio(name,uri,vol){
 if(window.HOJA_AUDIO_CONTROL?.sfxOn===false)return;
 if(!context){return;}if(context.state!=='running')await context.resume().catch(()=>{});
 if(context.state!=='running')return;
 const now=performance.now();if(now-(lastAt[name]||-1e9)<110)return;lastAt[name]=now;
 try{
  let promise=buffers.get(name);if(!promise){promise=context.decodeAudioData(decodeUri(uri));buffers.set(name,promise);}
  const buffer=await promise;if(window.HOJA_AUDIO_CONTROL?.sfxOn===false)return;
  const src=context.createBufferSource(),gain=context.createGain();
  src.buffer=buffer;gain.gain.value=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,vol));src.connect(gain);gain.connect(context.destination);
  if(name==='sleep'&&activeSnore){try{activeSnore.stop();}catch(_){}}
  if(name==='sleep')activeSnore=src;
  src.onended=()=>{if(activeSnore===src)activeSnore=null;};src.start(0);played++;
 }catch(e){buffers.delete(name);console.warn('Tutorial SFX playback error',name,e);}
}
function stopSnore(){if(activeSnore){try{activeSnore.stop();}catch(_){}activeSnore=null;}}
window.addEventListener('message',e=>{
 const frame=document.getElementById('hojaTutApp'),overlay=document.getElementById('hojaTutOverlay');
 if(e.source!==frame?.contentWindow||overlay?.hidden)return;
 if(e.data?.kind==='HOJA_TUTORIAL_SFX_PLAY'&&/^[-_a-z0-9]+$/i.test(e.data.name||'')&&typeof e.data.source==='string'&&e.data.source.startsWith('data:audio/'))
   void playAudio(e.data.name,e.data.source,e.data.volume);
 else if(e.data?.kind==='HOJA_TUTORIAL_SFX_STOP_SNORE')stopSnore();
});
window.HOJA_TUTORIAL_AUDIO_BRIDGE={unlockFromGesture,stopSnore,get status(){return {context:context?.state||'uninitialized',cached:buffers.size,played}}};
})();
</script>

<script id="hojaR17STutorialArcadeDelta" type="application/octet-stream"></script>
<script id="hojaR17STutorialNativeBridge">
/* R17S: one canonical arcade HTML, one native Phaser scene definition.
   Stage 0 is reconstructed from a small audited delta on demand. */
window.HOJA_R17S_NATIVE_SOURCE=(function(){
 let cache=null;
 const EXPECT_LINES=12793;
 const EXPECT_BYTES=1968845;
 function getOps(){
  const raw=atob(document.getElementById('hojaR17STutorialArcadeDelta').textContent.trim());
  return JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(Uint8Array.from(raw,c=>c.charCodeAt(0))));
 }
 // 40-6BG: practice mode teaches the CURRENT arcade controls (A/D move, ',' run, '.' jump, W door, S stomp/pipe,
 // Enter/click dialogue). Exact-count substitutions: any drift fails closed instead of half-patching.
 function hojaSubExact_(html,list,label){
  for(const [before,after,n] of list){
   const c=html.split(before).length-1;
   if(c!==n)throw new Error(label+' 조작키 안내 원본 불일치('+c+'/'+n+'): '+before.slice(0,24));
   html=html.split(before).join(after);
  }
  return html;
 }
 async function build(){
  if(cache)return cache;
  const canonical=await window.HOJA_GAMEPLAY.getCanonicalArcade();
  const lines=canonical.split('\n');
  if(lines.length!==EXPECT_LINES)throw new Error('R17S 원본 아케이드 줄 수 변경 · 자동 병합 차단');
  const patches=getOps();
  for(let n=patches.length-1;n>=0;n--){
   const [a,b,oldLines,newLines]=patches[n];
   // The eye-rendering stability update inserted 85 audited lines at source line 4272.
   // Original R17S positions before that point are unchanged; later positions move +85.
   const shift=a>=4272?85:0,from=a+shift,to=b+shift;
   if(lines.slice(from,to).join('\n')!==oldLines.join('\n'))
    throw new Error('R17S 원본 아케이드 버전 불일치: patch '+n);
   lines.splice(from,to-from,...newLines);
  }
  const html=lines.join('\n');
  if(new TextEncoder().encode(html).length!==EXPECT_BYTES ||
     !html.includes('window.HOJA_TUTORIAL_NATIVE=true;') ||
     !html.includes('HOJA_TUTORIAL_NATIVE_STAGE'))
    throw new Error('R17S 스테이지0 조립 검증 실패');
  if(!html.includes('let ACTIVE_SCENE=null;'))throw new Error('연습 터치 장면 앵커 누락');
  const touch=window.HOJA_TT_ARCADE_BRIDGE_SOURCE.replace("const m=e.data;","const m=e.data;if(m.action==='down')window.focus();");
  cache=window.HOJA_ARCADE_APPROVED_TRIAL.patchControls(hojaSubExact_(html.replace('let ACTIVE_SCENE=null;','let ACTIVE_SCENE=null;'+touch),
   [["if(!event||window.parent===window||(k!=='Space'&&k!=='Enter'))return;", "if(!event||window.parent===window||k!=='Enter')return;", 1], ["if(!pending||window.parent===window||(ev.code!=='Enter'&&ev.code!=='Space'))return;", "if(!pending||window.parent===window||ev.code!=='Enter')return;", 1]],'연습 스테이지'));
  return cache;
 }
 return {build,get info(){return {cached:!!cache,deltaBytes:15572,expectedBytes:EXPECT_BYTES}}};
})();
</script>
<script id="hojaR17LTutorialIntegration">
(function(){'use strict';
 const STORAGE='hoja_tutorial_stage0_completed_v1';
 const overlay=document.getElementById('hojaTutOverlay'), frame=document.getElementById('hojaTutApp');
 const originalBack=document.getElementById('hojaSharedBack'),originalAudio=document.getElementById('hojaAudioTop');
 const originals=new Map();
 let running=false,finished=false,sessionCompleted=false,waiting=null,mode='practice',loading=null;
 function completed(){try{return sessionCompleted||localStorage.getItem(STORAGE)==='1';}catch(_e){return sessionCompleted;}}
 function save(){sessionCompleted=true;try{localStorage.setItem(STORAGE,'1');return true;}catch(_e){return false;}}
 // 40-6BG: practice mode teaches the CURRENT arcade controls (A/D move, ',' run, '.' jump, W door, S stomp/pipe,
 // Enter/click dialogue). Exact-count substitutions: any drift fails closed instead of half-patching.
 function hojaSubExact_(html,list,label){
  for(const [before,after,n] of list){
   const c=html.split(before).length-1;
   if(c!==n)throw new Error(label+' 조작키 안내 원본 불일치('+c+'/'+n+'): '+before.slice(0,24));
   html=html.split(before).join(after);
  }

 }
 async function decode(){
  if(loading)return loading;

    const b=atob(document.getElementById('hojaR17KTutorialGzip').textContent.trim());
    const v=Uint8Array.from(b,c=>c.charCodeAt(0));
    const decoded=hojaSubExact_(await new Response(new Blob([v]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream('gzip'))).text(),
     [["이동: ← → / A D · 달리기: Shift 또는 좌우 더블탭 · 문: ↑ / W", "이동: A · D · 달리기: , (쉼표) 누른 채 이동 · 문: W", 1], ["대화: 클릭 / Enter / Space · 야외 점프: Space / ↑ / W · 스톰프: 공중에서 S / ↓ · 문/토관: ↑/↓", "대화: 클릭 / Enter · 점프: . (마침표) · 스톰프: 공중에서 S · 문: W · 토관: S · 도움말: H", 1], ["'WASD나 방향키로 움직여 봐.'", "'A 키와 D 키로 좌우로 움직여 봐.'", 1], ["'Shift키를 누르고 있거나 빠르게 왼쪽, 오른쪽 버튼을 두 번 누르면 달릴 수 있어.'", "'쉼표(,) 키를 누른 채로 움직이면 달릴 수 있어.'", 1], ["'문 앞에 서서 W키나 위쪽 방향키를 눌러 봐.'", "'문 앞에 서서 W 키를 눌러 봐.'", 1], ["'Enter 또는 Space로 대화를 이어가세요'", "'클릭하거나 Enter로 대화를 이어가세요'", 3], ["'WASD 또는 방향키로 이동해 보세요'", "'A · D 키로 이동해 보세요'", 1], ["'Shift 또는 방향키 두 번 눌러 달려 보세요'", "'쉼표(,)를 누른 채 이동해서 달려 보세요'", 1], ["'문 앞에서 W 또는 ↑를 눌러 보세요'", "'문 앞에서 W를 눌러 보세요'", 1], ["'Space · W · ↑로 높은 곳에 올라가 보세요'", "'마침표(.)로 점프해서 높은 곳에 올라가 보세요'", 1], ["'공중에서 S · ↓로 유령을 제거해 보세요'", "'점프한 뒤 공중에서 S로 유령을 제거해 보세요'", 1], ["'토관 위에서 S · ↓를 눌러 보세요'", "'토관 위에서 S를 눌러 보세요'", 1], ["'← → 또는 A D로 움직여 봐!'", "'A · D로 움직여 봐!'", 1], ["'Shift를 누르며 이동하거나 방향키를 빠르게 두 번 눌러 달려 봐!'", "'쉼표(,)를 누른 채 이동해서 달려 봐!'", 1], ["'문 앞에서 ↑ 또는 W를 눌러 밖으로 나가자!'", "'문 앞에서 W를 눌러 밖으로 나가자!'", 1], ["'Space나 ↑, W를 눌러 점프해 봐.'", "'마침표(.) 키를 눌러 점프해 봐.'", 1], ["'점프한 뒤 공중에서 S나 ↓를 눌러 슈퍼엉덩이찍기를 써 봐.'", "'점프한 뒤 공중에서 S 키를 눌러 슈퍼엉덩이찍기를 써 봐.'", 1], ["'토관 위에 올라가 S나 ↓를 눌러 봐.'", "'토관 위에 올라가 S 키를 눌러 봐.'", 1], ["화면 클릭 · Enter/Space로 계속 ▸", "대화창 클릭 · Enter로 계속 ▸", 1], ["let dx=(keys.has('ArrowRight')||keys.has('KeyD')?1:0)-(keys.has('ArrowLeft')||keys.has('KeyA')?1:0);", "let dx=(keys.has('KeyD')?1:0)-(keys.has('KeyA')?1:0);", 1], ["let run=(keys.has('ShiftLeft')||keys.has('ShiftRight')||performance.now()<state.doubleRunUntil)&&state.phase!=='move';", "let run=keys.has('Comma')&&state.phase!=='move';", 1], ["if(state.dialogueOpen){if(k==='Enter'||k==='Space'){", "if(state.dialogueOpen){if(k==='Enter'){", 1], ["if(state.phase==='door'&&(k==='KeyW'||k==='ArrowUp')&&", "if(state.phase==='door'&&k==='KeyW'&&", 1], ["['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','ArrowUp','ArrowDown','Space','KeyW','KeyA','KeyS','KeyD','ShiftLeft','ShiftRight','Enter'].includes(k))e.preventDefault();", "['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','ArrowUp','ArrowDown','Space','KeyW','KeyA','KeyS','KeyD','ShiftLeft','ShiftRight','Enter','Comma','Period'].includes(k))e.preventDefault();", 1], ["if(['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','KeyA','KeyD'].includes(e.code)&&!e.repeat", "if(['KeyA','KeyD'].includes(e.code)&&!e.repeat", 1]],'연습모드');
    const patch='<scr'+'ipt>'+window.HOJA_TT_PRACTICE_SOURCE+'</scr'+'ipt>';
    return decoded.includes('</body>')?decoded.replace('</body>',patch+'</body>'):decoded+patch;
  })();return loading;
 }
 function syncAudio(){const a=window.HOJA_AUDIO_CONTROL;
   if(!running)return;
   try{frame.contentWindow?.postMessage({kind:'HOJA_TUTORIAL_AUDIO_STATE',sfxOn:a?.sfxOn!==false,musicOn:a?.musicOn!==false},'*');}catch(_){}
 }
 function backCapture(e){e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();close(false);}
 function mountSharedControls(){
   for(const el of [originalBack,originalAudio]){
     if(!el||originals.has(el))continue;
     const place=document.createComment('hoja tutorial shared control return');
     el.parentNode.insertBefore(place,el);
     originals.set(el,{place,hidden:el.hidden});
     overlay.appendChild(el);el.hidden=false;
   }
   originalBack?.addEventListener('click',backCapture,true);
   window.HOJA_AUDIO_CONTROL?.render?.();
 }
 function restoreSharedControls(){
   originalBack?.removeEventListener('click',backCapture,true);
   for(const [el,prior] of originals){
     prior.place?.replaceWith(el);
     el.hidden=prior.hidden;
   }
   originals.clear();window.HOJA_AUDIO_CONTROL?.render?.();
 }
 async function open(which='practice',after=null){
   if(running)return;
   running=true;finished=false;mode=which;waiting=after;
   overlay.hidden=false;document.body.style.overflow='hidden';mountSharedControls();
   window.HOJA_TUTORIAL_AUDIO_BRIDGE?.unlockFromGesture();
   // Existing music track is shared; it must be unlocked from a genuine player click.
   window.HOJA_AUDIO_CONTROL?.unlockFromGesture?.();
   try{const html=await decode();if(!running)return;
     frame.addEventListener('load',syncAudio,{once:true});frame.srcdoc=html;
   }catch(e){close(false);alert('튜토리얼을 열 수 없습니다: '+e.message);}
 }
 function close(continueArcade=false){
   if(!running)return;
   const action=waiting;
   running=false;window.HOJA_TUTORIAL_AUDIO_BRIDGE?.stopSnore();frame.removeAttribute('srcdoc');frame.src='about:blank';restoreSharedControls();overlay.hidden=true;
   document.body.style.overflow='';waiting=null;
   if(continueArcade&&mode==='arcade'&&finished&&typeof action==='function')action();
 }
 window.addEventListener('message',event=>{if(event.source!==frame.contentWindow||!running)return;
   if(event.data?.kind==='HOJA_TUT_SHARED_PORTRAITS_REQUEST'){
     const bundle=JSON.parse(document.getElementById('hojaTeamR10PortraitAssets').textContent);
     const chars=['CHILJIDO_ELDER','HOJA','NAHANSANG'];
     const moods=['01_NEUTRAL','02_SURPRISED','03_ANGRY','04_TIRED','05_SHY','06_SAD','07_SLEEPY','08_EMBARRASSED','09_SPARKLING','10_CURIOUS'];
     const assets={};
     for(const ch of chars)for(let n=0;n<moods.length;n++)
       assets['portrait_'+ch+'_'+String(n+1).padStart(2,'0')+'.webp']=bundle.characters[ch].emotions[moods[n]].imageData;
     const audioRefs={'hojaTutSfx_dialogue': 'sfx_collect', 'hojaTutSfx_walk': 'sfx_step_grass1', 'hojaTutSfx_run': 'sfx_step_grass2', 'hojaTutSfx_jump': 'sfx_hop', 'hojaTutSfx_land': 'sfx_land', 'hojaTutSfx_door': 'sfx_stagestart', 'hojaTutSfx_enemy': 'sfx_stomp1', 'hojaTutSfx_stomp': 'sfx_strong', 'hojaTutSfx_question': 'sfx_collect', 'hojaTutSfx_right': 'hqSfx_correct', 'hojaTutSfx_wrong': 'hqSfx_wrong', 'hojaTutSfx_finish': 'sfx_clear'};
     const media={audio:{},images:{}};
     for(const [dest,src] of Object.entries(audioRefs)){
       const uri=document.getElementById(src)?.getAttribute('src')||'';
       if(!uri.startsWith('data:audio/'))throw new Error('R17S 공용 MP3 누락: '+src);
       media.audio[dest]=uri;
     }
     for(const [dest,src] of [['walk','hojaModeWalk'],['nahan_walk','nahanModeWalk']]){
       const uri=document.getElementById(src)?.getAttribute('src')||'';
       if(!uri.startsWith('data:image/png;'))throw new Error('R17S 공용 스프라이트 누락: '+src);
       media.images[dest]=uri;
     }
     event.source.postMessage({kind:'HOJA_TUT_SHARED_PORTRAITS',assets,media},'*');
     return;
   }
   if(event.data?.kind==='HOJA_TUT_NATIVE_SOURCE_REQUEST'){
     const requester=event.source;
     void window.HOJA_R17S_NATIVE_SOURCE.build().then(html=>{
       if(running&&frame.contentWindow===requester)
         requester.postMessage({kind:'HOJA_TUT_NATIVE_SOURCE_RESPONSE',html},'*');
     }).catch(error=>{
       if(running&&frame.contentWindow===requester)
         requester.postMessage({kind:'HOJA_TUT_NATIVE_SOURCE_ERROR',error:String(error.message||error)},'*');
     });
     return;
   }
   if(event.data?.kind==='HOJA_TUTORIAL_SFX_READY'){syncAudio();return;}
   if(event.data?.kind==='HOJA_TUTORIAL_COMPLETED'&&event.data.version==='v057'){
     finished=true;save();document.getElementById('hojaTutStatus').textContent='튜토리얼을 완료했습니다.';
   } else if(event.data?.kind==='HOJA_TUTORIAL_CONTINUE'&&event.data.version==='v057'){close(true);}
 });
 window.HOJA_TUTORIAL_GATE={open,startArcade(launch){if(completed())launch();else open('arcade',launch);},
   get state(){return {running,finished,completed:completed()};}};
})();
</script>

<script id="hojaProdUsageTelemetry">
/* Anonymous, best-effort game start. Must never prevent game play. */
window.HOJA_USAGE=Object.freeze({
  track(mode,teamCount){
    try{
      const gs=window.google?.script?.run,sources=window.HOJA_B_LIVE?.sources;
      if(!gs||!Array.isArray(sources)||sources.length<1||sources.length>5)return;
      const ids=sources.map(x=>String(x?.data?.cartridgeId||'').trim());
      if(ids.some(x=>!/^[0-9]{1,11}$/.test(x)))return;
      const eventId=window.crypto?.randomUUID?.();
      if(!eventId)return;
      gs.withSuccessHandler(()=>{}).withFailureHandler(()=>{}).recordUsageStartU1({
        eventId,mode,repositoryKind:'PUBLIC',cartridgeCount:ids.length,
        cartridgeIds:ids,teamCount
      });
    }catch(_ignored){}
  }
});
</script>

<script id="hojaTeacherToolsArcadeSourceV1">window.HOJA_TT_ARCADE_BRIDGE_SOURCE="  /* TT TOUCH V7: actual Phaser keys; acknowledge action from inner game. */\n  (function hojaTTArcadeTouchReceiver(){\n    const names=Object.freeze({ArrowLeft:'a',ArrowRight:'d',ArrowUp:'w',ArrowDown:'s',Space:'jump',ShiftLeft:'run',KeyF:'fps'});\n    const held=new Set();\n    function getKey(code){return ACTIVE_SCENE?.keys?.[names[code]]||null}\n    function releaseKey(code){\n      held.delete(code);const key=getKey(code);if(!key)return false;\n      key.isDown=false;key.isUp=true;key._justDown=false;key._justUp=true;key.timeUp=performance.now();return true;\n    }\n    function releaseAll(){for(const code of [...held])releaseKey(code)}\n    window.addEventListener('message',function(e){\n      if(e.source!==window.parent||!e.data||e.data.kind!=='HOJA_TT_ARCADE_INPUT')return;\n      const m=e.data;\n      if(m.action==='releaseAll'){releaseAll();return;}\n      if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(names,m.code)||!['down','up'].includes(m.action))return;\n      let applied=false;\n      if(m.action==='up'){applied=releaseKey(m.code)}\n      else {\n        const key=getKey(m.code);\n        if(key){\n          applied=true;\n          if(!held.has(m.code)){\n            held.add(m.code);key.isDown=true;key.isUp=false;\n            key._justDown=true;key._justUp=false;\n            key.timeDown=performance.now();key.repeats=0;\n          }\n          if(ACTIVE_SCENE?.quizActive){\n            const keyNames={ArrowLeft:'ArrowLeft',ArrowRight:'ArrowRight',ArrowUp:'ArrowUp',ArrowDown:'ArrowDown',Space:' ',ShiftLeft:'Shift',KeyF:'f'};\n            window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{code:m.code,key:keyNames[m.code],bubbles:true}));\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      try{window.parent.postMessage({kind:'HOJA_TT_ARCADE_APPLIED',seq:m.seq,code:m.code,action:m.action,applied},'*')}catch{}\n    });\n    window.addEventListener('pagehide',releaseAll);\n    window.HOJA_TT_ARCADE_TOUCH_TEST={releaseAll,get held(){return [...held]}};\n  })();\n";</script>

<script id="hojaTeacherToolsPracticeSourceV8">window.HOJA_TT_PRACTICE_SOURCE="/* Runs in the decoded tutorial document, with its existing state and keys. */\n(function(){\n 'use strict';\n const codes=new Set(['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','ArrowUp','ArrowDown','Space','ShiftLeft','KeyF']);\n const held=new Set();\n const names={Space:' ',ShiftLeft:'Shift',KeyF:'f'};\n function ack(m,applied,stage){window.parent.postMessage({kind:'HOJA_TT_ARCADE_APPLIED',seq:m.seq,code:m.code,action:m.action,applied,stage},'*');}\n const toNew={ArrowLeft:'KeyA',ArrowRight:'KeyD',ArrowUp:'KeyW',ArrowDown:'KeyS',ShiftLeft:'Comma',Space:'Enter'};\n function dispatch(type,code){code=toNew[code]||code;window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(type,{code,key:names[code]||code,bubbles:true,cancelable:true}));}\n function releaseAll(){for(const code of held){dispatch('keyup',code);keys.delete(toNew[code]||code)}held.clear();document.getElementById('hojaStage0Native')?.contentWindow?.postMessage({kind:'HOJA_TT_ARCADE_INPUT',action:'releaseAll'},'*');}\n window.addEventListener('message',e=>{\n  const native=document.getElementById('hojaStage0Native');\n  if(e.source===native?.contentWindow&&e.data?.kind==='HOJA_TT_ARCADE_APPLIED'){window.parent.postMessage(e.data,'*');return;}\n  if(e.source!==window.parent||e.data?.kind!=='HOJA_TT_PRACTICE_INPUT')return;\n  const m=e.data;\n  if(m.action==='releaseAll'){releaseAll();ack(m,true,'release');return;}\n  if(!codes.has(m.code)||!['down','up'].includes(m.action))return;\n  if(state.zone==='native'&&native&&(m.action==='up'||!state.dialogueOpen)){\n    if(m.action==='up'){held.delete(m.code);dispatch('keyup',m.code);keys.delete(toNew[m.code]||m.code)}\n    native.contentWindow.postMessage({...m,kind:'HOJA_TT_ARCADE_INPUT'},'*');return;\n  }\n  if(m.action==='down'){\n    window.focus();\n    if(!held.has(m.code)){held.add(m.code);dispatch('keydown',m.code)}\n  }else{held.delete(m.code);dispatch('keyup',m.code);keys.delete(toNew[m.code]||m.code)}\n  ack(m,true,state.dialogueOpen?'dialogue':'museum');\n });\n window.addEventListener('pagehide',releaseAll);\n})();\n";</script>
<script id="hojaTeacherToolsTouchV1">
/* Teacher Tools local dashboard -> HtmlService game -> actual Phaser scene. TEST ONLY. */
(function(){
  'use strict';
  const channel='HOJA_TT_TOUCH_V1';
  const allowed=/^http:\/\/(?:127\.0\.0\.1|localhost)(?::\d+)?$/;
  const codes=new Set(['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','ArrowUp','ArrowDown','Space','ShiftLeft','KeyF']);
  let accepted=false;
  function notify(kind,other={}){
    try{window.top.postMessage({kind,channel,...other},'*')}catch(_){ }
  }
  function ready(){notify('HOJA_TT_READY')}
  window.addEventListener('message',event=>{
    // Inner Phaser is a separate srcdoc iframe: its ACK must be forwarded upward.
    const inner=document.getElementById('hqArcadeFrame');
    const practice=document.getElementById('hojaTutApp');
    if((event.source===inner?.contentWindow||event.source===practice?.contentWindow) && event.data?.kind==='HOJA_TT_ARCADE_APPLIED'){
      notify('HOJA_TT_PHASER_APPLIED',{
        seq:event.data.seq,code:event.data.code,action:event.data.action,applied:!!event.data.applied,stage:event.data.stage
      });
      return;
    }
    if(event.source!==window.top||!allowed.test(event.origin))return;
    const m=event.data;
    if(!m||m.channel!==channel)return;
    if(m.kind==='HOJA_TT_ACK'){accepted=true;notify('HOJA_TT_ACKNOWLEDGED');return;}
